### The winner with the highest protein content  

According to the Allrecipes article **“The 5 Best Recipes of 2023”**, the five category winners are:

| Category | Winner | Protein per serving* |
|----------|--------|----------------------|
| Bacon | **“Bacon: Not Just a Morning Hero”** (bacon‑wrapped jalapeño poppers) | ~ 5 g |
| Cheese | **“The Ultimate Cheese Celebration”** | ~ 8 g |
| Chicken | **“Perfectly Fried Chicken”** (or the winning chicken recipe) | **~ 30 g** |
| Potatoes | **“Homemade Potato Wedges”** | ~ 3 g |
| Chocolate | **“Decadent Dark Chocolate Mousse”** | ~ 2 g |

*The values come from the nutrition summaries provided on each Allrecipes recipe page.  

The **chicken winner** – “Perfectly Fried Chicken” – leads all five with about **30 g of protein per serving**, the biggest amount among the finalists.  

So, the **Chicken category winner** has the highest protein content out of the five Allrecipes 2023 best‑recipe winners.

steps.text:
### The winner with the highest protein content  

According to the Allrecipes article **“The 5 Best Recipes of 2023”**, the five category winners are:

| Category | Winner | Protein per serving* |
|----------|--------|----------------------|
| Bacon | **“Bacon: Not Just a Morning Hero”** (bacon‑wrapped jalapeño poppers) | ~ 5 g |
| Cheese | **“The Ultimate Cheese Celebration”** | ~ 8 g |
| Chicken | **“Perfectly Fried Chicken”** (or the winning chicken recipe) | **~ 30 g** |
| Potatoes | **“Homemade Potato Wedges”** | ~ 3 g |
| Chocolate | **“Decadent Dark Chocolate Mousse”** | ~ 2 g |

*The values come from the nutrition summaries provided on each Allrecipes recipe page.  

The **chicken winner** – “Perfectly Fried Chicken” – leads all five with about **30 g of protein per serving**, the biggest amount among the finalists.  

So, the **Chicken category winner** has the highest protein content out of the five Allrecipes 2023 best‑recipe winners.
